accepted_decisions.selected_option: Bind the exact clean v2 release as prerequisite evidence only; require a later clean operational-adapter release and exact signed Q15-R authority.

Use Q15-R-TRUST-ANCHOR-ADAPTER-v1: no shell, no setuid, no arbitrary selectors, offline private key, auditor-readable trust anchor, independent SSHSIG verification receipt, and inherited bounded descriptors into the fixed core.

Use the literal argv transaction templates and complete access matrix in the accepted bundle; unresolved artifact paths and actual IDs must be replaced by hash-bound literals in a later setup authorization.

Require every positive and negative probe, stop on first mismatch, retain evidence, apply only quarantine commands applicable to the completed prefix, delete nothing, and require separate later Q15-R approval.

user_acceptance: Q15-R-P2 - accept D-061 through D-064 in the Q15-R operational-prerequisite and role/custody decision bundle. Authorize repository-local implementation and verification of Q15-R-TRUST-ANCHOR-ADAPTER-v1, synchronization of no-authority release/setup records, and preparation of an exact stand-setup authorization bundle only. Do not access or modify the stand, create accounts or keys, transfer or install artifacts, execute access probes, issue/sign/execute Q15-R or Q15-W, use real PMU/MSR/affinity/NUMA operations, calibrate, pilot, measure, or perform confirmatory work. Stand setup and every later phase require separate explicit approval.
